settings.accordion_text:
BKM Electrolytes was created to close a gap the founders, Swedish former top athletes, kept running into. Most electrolytes are built for heavy sweating and pack in far more sodium than your body needs on an ordinary day. When you haven't earned it through sweat, that extra salt is simply a load for your liver and kidneys to process.

So we built an electrolyte you can genuinely drink every day. Guérande sea salt and coconut water powder deliver full-spectrum minerals, the sodium is calibrated lower for daily use, and it scales with your effort: 1 scoop on a normal day, 2 when you train, up to 3 for the hardest sessions. NAC helps support your liver and kidneys, a prebiotic + probiotic gut layer helps you absorb what you take, and acerola Vitamin C, Vitamin D3 and selenium round out the formula. Naturally sweetened with stevia, no added sugar.

40 servings per bag (200 g), roughly 20-40 days depending on your daily dose.

Mix 1 scoop (5 g) in 300-400 ml of water.

Scale to your day: 1 scoop for everyday hydration, 2 scoops when you train hard or sweat heavily. Many also take a glass before and the day after a social occasion.

Guérande Sea Salt (extra fine): Hand-harvested on the French Atlantic coast and measured for its mineral level, with its full trace-mineral profile intact, the mineral complexity refined sodium chloride strips away.

Coconut Water Powder: A natural source of potassium and minerals for everyday hydration.

Magnesium (citrate): A well-absorbed form of magnesium, involved in 300+ processes including energy, muscle recovery and electrolyte balance.

NAC (N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine): Rarely found in an electrolyte. A precursor to glutathione that helps support the liver and kidneys, part of why the sodium can stay calibrated for daily use.

Acerola Vitamin C: A naturally derived source of Vitamin C for antioxidant support.

Inulin (chicory root) + LactoSpore® probiotic: A prebiotic + probiotic gut layer that works together so your body actually absorbs the minerals you take.

Vitamin D3 + Selenium: Two micronutrients many adults fall short on, supporting immune defence and thyroid function. Selenium also works in synergy with NAC.

Consistency is key for a daily mineral routine.

settings.title: How is this different from a regular electrolyte drink?
settings.text: Most electrolytes are built for heavy sweating and pack in more sodium than your body needs on an ordinary day. BKM is calibrated lower so you can drink it daily, then scales up when you train. It also goes further than salt and sugar: full-spectrum Guérande minerals and coconut water powder, NAC to support your liver and kidneys, and a prebiotic + probiotic gut layer for real absorption.

settings.title: Can I take it every day?
settings.text: Yes, that's exactly what it's built for. The sodium is calibrated for daily use, so it's a daily mineral routine for everyone, not just athletes. Take 1 scoop on a normal day and 2 when you train hard or sweat heavily.

settings.title: When should I drink it?
settings.text: Whenever you need clean, balanced hydration, morning, around training, or through a warm day. Many also take a glass before and the day after a social occasion, to help the body rebalance.

settings.title: What's the difference between Swedish Berries and Elderflower Lime?
settings.text:
Swedish Berries is the sweeter of the two, built around Swedish berries with notes of blueberry, strawberry and raspberry. Rounder and fuller, for those who like a little more sweetness.

Elderflower Lime is fresher and crisper, Swedish elderflower lifted with lime for a light, slightly tart finish. Both are naturally sweetened with stevia and contain no added sugar.

settings.title: Does it contain sugar?
settings.text: No. BKM Electrolytes has no added sugar and is naturally sweetened with stevia.
